description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You see, or seek to see, mathematical patterns everywhere around you. Everything can be counted and calculated after all. Most people just try hard enough - but you do. You count everything: the number of steps in staircases, the number of people in the town square, the sum the dice rolls in the gamblers den... and it all has some hidden meaning. Good numbers please you, and bad numbers are foreboding. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.sBHarYXR2o7jD1VY]{Super Numerate} Talent. You can become transfixed when you are faced with a particularly complex counting challenge, like when trying to keep track of the warriors o a battlefield, the dice in a gambling den or the coins in the counting house. The GM can ask you to pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or have your Initiative reduced to zero in such situations. You can only gain this mutation once.
